styleGuide.renderStyle: 2D dark-fantasy anime game sprite; crisp readable silhouette; controlled painterly shading; consistent line weight
styleGuide.camera: orthographic 3/4 game sprite; same scale and ground anchor in every frame
styleGuide.consistency: same face, body proportions, costume, weapon, palette and accessories across every direction and state
styleGuide.animation: clear pose changes; no duplicate adjacent frames; stable camera; no background; no text; no UI
styleGuide.directionRule: draw all eight directions as genuinely distinct views; never mirror another direction
styleGuide.qualityGate: manual art review plus automated alpha, bounds, dimensions, duplicate-frame and silhouette-continuity checks
